items.name: readme-writing
items.title: Readme Writing
items.description: Write or restructure a README that gets a reader from landing to first success in minutes: a one-line purpose, a working quick start verified against the actual code, then usage, configuration, and contribution pointers in the order a new user needs them, with nothing the code contradicts. Reads the repository first and never documents behaviour it has not confirmed. Use when a project has no README, when the README has drifted from the code, or before publishing a package or repository.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
